ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal intensity distribution with high contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity pixels (>220 intensity) on distal lobes versus 60% low-to-mid intensity pixels in central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the distal 30% of each lobe; the medial 40% consists of high-frequency salt-and-pepper mottling; low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated at the central peduncle insertion and along the inferior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 12% of the maximum vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 5 to 20 pixels, with the most pronounced peaks located on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep from the median notch to the superiorly-angled lateral tips; the outer lobe edges follow a smooth upward mathematical curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (6-10 units per side) located on the extreme lateral margins/tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear disruption (white pixel line) on the left lobe at approximately 35% width; several short, unaligned diagonal linear marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear scar on the mid-left lobe; barnacle colonization on both lateral tips; irregular notch on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe.
